## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test or tooling

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks performed. Do not mark checks complete unless you ran them.

- [ ] `node --test tests/smoke.test.mjs`
- [ ] Manual browser checks (describe browser and viewport)
- [ ] Keyboard and form-label checks, where relevant
- [ ] CSV import/export checks, where relevant

## Privacy and security impact

- [ ] No new data leaves the browser.
- [ ] Any change to data handling, network access, or storage is documented.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or real customer data are included.

Explain any item that does not apply or needs review.

## Screenshots or evidence

Add screenshots, test output, or reproduction steps when useful.

## Limitations and follow-up

Document known limitations, deferred work, and any compatibility concerns.
